description:

title: Supply Chain & Operations Specialist
description:
Supply Chain & Operations Specialist - Join Us at Miss Amara!

If youâre a natural problem-solver who loves keeping things moving in a fast-paced e-commerce world, this role is for you.

As our Supply Chain & Operations Specialist, youâll be the driving force ensuring our DTC and B2B orders are delivered smoothly and on time. By tackling fulfillment bottlenecks with your amazing attention to detail, you'll directly protect our brand trust and keep our customers smiling!

About The Role

Youâll be the heart of our daily outbound operations! You will coordinate dispatch, manage inventory and returns, and keep our logistics dashboards up to date.

Working closely with our logistics partners and CX team, youâll ensure everything flows beautifully. Weâd love for you to bring fresh ideas! Youâll have the freedom to spot process gaps, streamline manual tasks, and help us scale our operations as we grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Order Management: Process and manage DTC and B2B orders across all channels, ensuring accurate statuses and seamless fulfillment across our systems.
  • Logistics Coordination: Work directly with warehouse teams and freight carriers to manage dispatch and swiftly resolve any booking issues or pickup delays.
  • Issue Resolution: Act as the primary go-to for Operations escalations, communicating directly with marketplaces to resolve order issues, delays, and fulfillment bottlenecks.
  • Inventory & Returns: Handle day-to-day inventory tasks, including returns, stock adjustments, and reconciliations in collaboration with our Ops and CX teams.
  • Stock Integrity: Monitor inventory levels closely, proactively flagging any discrepancies or stock mismatches between Cin7, the WMS, and our marketplace channels.
  • Inbound Support: Provide secondary backup for inbound logistics, assisting with shipping booking

title: Product Engineer
description:
About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.
